voice.text: This week's fable animal is the frog. A frog was once a tiny egg! [pause] What about the bean plant? Did it start small and change too? Tap your guess.
Every living thing has a life story that goes <emphasis>in order</emphasis> — a life cycle. [pause] Remember the frog? It starts as a tiny egg in the pond.
The egg hatches into a <emphasis>tadpole</emphasis>. It has a tail and swims. [pause] Under water, it breathes like a fish does.

Then the tadpole grows legs and becomes a <emphasis>froglet</emphasis>. Its tail shrinks, and it starts to breathe air. [pause] Soon it is a grown frog — and the frog lays new eggs. The circle goes round!
Plants have life cycles too! [pause] A bean seed wakes up in the soil and grows a sprout. The sprout becomes a plant, and the plant makes flowers.

The flower makes <emphasis>new seeds</emphasis> — and the circle goes round again. [pause] Look at them side by side. Both are circles. Both go in order. Animal and plant alike — each starts from a little beginning that grows: an egg, or a seed.
Build the frog's life circle! [pause] Tap the stage that goes in the glowing spot.
Now the bean plant! [pause] Tap the stage that goes in the glowing spot.
Now think about both circles at once — frog and bean!
